description: The site was restructured 2026-08-30 (story-first index, atlas.html reference, dementia unchanged in substance) and reviewed; fixes landed in edd902e + 374db04. Please independently verify: (1) FACTS - every checkable number and chemical claim on all three pages (terpene counts and formulas, C21H30O2 trio claims, R/S vs (+)/(-) conventions in the hands figure caption, Epidiolex claim, citation attributions incl. Pike 1988 and Coureaud 2022); (2) LINKS - all internal hrefs and anchors resolve, external DOIs land on the claimed papers; (3) MIRROR LAW - index.md/atlas.md/dementia.md are supersets of their pages (note: figcaption + summary extraction just added), full_site.txt = llms-full.txt, llms.txt/start.md/sitemap list the real pages; (4) VIEWERS - all 21 render across the two pages on a real device incl. a phone (viewer lifecycle: create near viewport, release far), reset buttons work, carvone pair counter-rotates mirror-locked; (5) PROSE SEAMS - the ladder reads as one voice, no leftover references to the pre-split structure. Report findings as comments here; do not merge or push page changes without the maintainer.

comments.text: SCOPE CLARIFICATION for the checker: the ONLY canonical sources are branch MAIN (at 374db04 or later) and the live site https://denson.github.io/aroma-atlas/ - pages index.html, atlas.html, dementia.html; figures are the five images/*.webp on main (carvone-hands, smell-path-carvone, configural-smell, cannabinoid-assemblies, entourage-ordinary). The old three-lane Y-molecule smell-path design is DEAD: it never shipped, and its only remaining copies lived on the superseded branch aa-27x/responsive-smell-path, which has now been DELETED from origin to remove the trap. If you have a local checkout of that branch or stale local files, discard them and re-fetch. Local webp verified byte-identical to the live deploy before this comment.

FACT finding - index.html says the six C10H16 terpenes have the identical sixteen atoms. C10H16 contains 26 atoms total: 10 C plus 16 H, not 16. PubChem confirms all six listed compounds and CIDs have formula C10H16 and MW 136.23, so the six-isomer count and formula are right; only the total-atom statement is wrong.

CITATION finding - index.html attributes DOI 10.1021/acsomega.4c03225 to Oswald et al., ACS Omega 2024. Crossref and ACS identify Twinkle R. Paryani as first author, with Oswald as last author: Paryani et al., Nonterpenoid Chemical Diversity of Cannabis Phenotypes Predicts Differentiated Aroma Characteristics, 2024. The DOI itself and the claimed subject are correct.

CURRENT-FRONTIER finding - the Rosenberg dronabinol study is no longer only an unverified 2024 conference or web figure. The version of record is Rosenberg et al., Am J Geriatr Psychiatry 2026, DOI 10.1016/j.jagp.2025.10.011, trial conducted 2017-2024. It supports safety and a significant PAS benefit, between-arm decline per week -0.74, p=.015, but the other co-primary NPI-C agitation outcome was not significant, p=.094. The repeated unqualified approximately 30 percent agitation reduction vs placebo and Rosenberg 24 wording should be updated and qualified against the primary paper.

OPENALEX and reproducibility finding - every exact citation count printed on dementia.html is already below current OpenAlex: Matsuda 5009 to 5027; Munro 5065 to 5096; Pertwee 1896 to 1934; Hampson 843 to 847; Ramirez 780 to 783; Benito 618 to 622; Esposito 296 to 305; Whiting 2108 to 2170, checked 2026-08-31. Add an as-of date or avoid exact live counts. Separately, main does not enumerate the nine seed papers behind the graph, so 21 works cited by at least 3, 5 of 9, 4 of 9, 3 of 6 recent, and 3-open or 6-blocked cannot be independently reproduced from the canonical repo or site.

MIRROR-LAW finding - the checked-in mirrors regenerate byte-identically, but gen_mirrors.py still omits visible page content. index.md omits the six-item .iso strip, namely the C10H16 terpene and aroma chips. dementia.md omits all three .new blocks under section 2, the three visible Pillar tag labels, and the SVG timeline visible study and year labels; the figcaption is present but not the labels. Thus index.md and dementia.md are not supersets of their HTML pages, and the omissions propagate into both full-corpus files.

CLEAN-CHECK summary - live bytes match main 374db04 for all three HTML pages, all mirrors, corpora, list files, and all five canonical WebPs. No dead three-lane Y-molecule figure exists among the five figures. All internal hrefs and anchors resolve; same-atoms.html is only a redirect and is absent from page lists; all DOI redirects and metadata match the claimed papers, with separate attribution findings above. full_site.txt is byte-identical to llms-full.txt; llms.txt, start.md, and sitemap list the real story, atlas, and dementia pages. Real-browser testing rendered all 21 viewers, 5 plus 16, at desktop and 390x844 with no fallback errors; near-viewport creation, far release, carvone opposite spin values and mirror behavior, drag and reset, and atlas reset with current style and spin all worked. The complexity-ladder prose reads continuously and the three HTML pages contain no leftover pre-split or same-atoms references.
